notes: The smallest tide: two bars in 4/4, a breath in (third, fourth, fifth, held) and a breath out (down by step to the home note). Hymn-like; it says the most when it is said slowly. Autumn: E Dorian, lower and rounder; the answer puts the theme in the bass on the cello under a high held line.
